clues.text: A boy ran to old Eli saying, "Here I am, for you have called me," but Eli had not called.
After a victory over the Philistines, he set up a stone between Mizpah and Shen, saying the LORD had helped them thus far.
In front of Jesse's sons, he took a horn of oil and anointed the youngest brother.
He poured a flask of oil on Saul's head, the young man who came searching for lost donkeys.
Because his own sons took bribes, Israel's elders came to him at Ramah and demanded a king.
Confronting King Saul over the spared Amalekite flocks, he declared that obedience is better than sacrifice.
When a medium called him up from the earth, Saul knew him as an old man wearing a robe.
